Our work

Sunshine Coast Mazda.

Dealership Promotional Campaign

Start a project More of our work

Long term Pepper clients, Sunshine Coast Mazda, are the Sunshine Coast’s number one Mazda Dealership. Over the years we shot many images and videos of the dealership, staff and of course cars.

In an endeavour to move away from traditional motor vehicle content Pepper created the “Encouraging Active Lifestyles” campaign. The campaign aims to promote Sunshine Coast Mazda in the Caloundra Region. This campaign had Pepper manage a collaboration between Sunshine Coast Mazda, Hit Bikes, Sunshine Coast Jetski, Liquid Force Kites as well as Your Mates Brewery. A series of five videos were shot highlighting the Mazda BT50 used in various active lifestyle settings.

This content was shared and promoted through the various collaboration partners for a great ongoing exposure in the local market.
